title: Fracture
subtitle: Model capability gaps, post-training, and cost-aware evaluation
body: A two-stage study of frontier versus 8B–27B edge models across 6 task categories and 16 benchmarks, comparing few-shot, SkillOpt, SFT, GRPO, and TTT-Discover with reproducible traces and cost ledgers.

title: Adversarial Agent Arena
subtitle: Heuristic vs. reinforcement-learning agents in games
body: A game-agnostic evaluation framework comparing heuristic-learning and RL agents through fixed seeds, role-swapped matches, replayable traces, win-rate/Elo reporting, and a headless Slime Volleyball calibration environment.
